commandPowerShell: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --mount "type=bind,source=$((Get-Location).Path)\spikes\signatures\ml-dsa,target=/proof,readonly" cafi-spikes:s1 python /proof/proof.py
binding: stdlib ctypes, direct OpenSSL EVP calls, no subprocess per operation

parameters.keyGeneration: EVP_PKEY_keygen_init and EVP_PKEY_generate; two independent keypairs, no supplied seed
parameters.signatureVerification: EVP_PKEY_verify_message_init and EVP_PKEY_verify; separate public-only keys from in-memory SPKI DER
parameters.payloadDescription: Fixed synthetic bytes with an embedded NUL; complete buffer and explicit length passed to EVP without a caller-side digest or message framing.

negativeCases.altered_payload: Flip one bit in the last byte after the embedded NUL; length unchanged.
negativeCases.altered_signature: Flip one bit in the first challenge byte; signature length unchanged.
negativeCases.different_key: Use the independently generated public key, whose raw bytes were confirmed to differ.
negativeCases.different_context: Supply a non-empty verification context with the same message, signature and public key.

sizeComparison.signatureRawBytes: 3309 per FIPS 204 Table 2; no ASN.1 wrapper.
sizeComparison.signatureBase64Chars: 4412 = 4 * ceil(3309/3), RFC 4648 standard Base64 (no line breaks; no '=' needed for 3309 bytes).
sizeComparison.publicKeyRawBytes: 1952 per FIPS 204 Table 2 and OpenSSL EVP_PKEY-ML-DSA 'pub' parameter.
sizeComparison.publicKeySpkiDerBytes: 1974 = 1952 + 22: per RFC 9881 sections 2/4, DER SEQUENCE header (4), AlgorithmIdentifier with OID 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.3.18 and absent parameters (13), and BIT STRING header and unused-bit count (5).
sizeComparison.publicKeySpkiPemBytes: 2726 = 2632 Base64 characters for the SPKI DER + 42 body LF bytes + 52 bytes of BEGIN/END PUBLIC KEY lines including LF (OpenSSL memory BIO, RFC 7468).

failurePropagation.perturbation: Verify the designated positive case with the one-bit-modified payload while still expecting acceptance.
failurePropagation.observed: EVP rejected the altered input (original: false); the script raised RuntimeError.

missingDependency.command: Same Docker options and image, replace the entrypoint arguments after the image with: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/proof'); import proof; proof.LIBRARY = proof.LIBRARY.with_name('missing-libcrypto.so.3'); proof.run()"
missingDependency.observed: ctypes.CDLL raised OSError (cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory); no success JSON.

limitations: Private keys and seeds are never extracted, measured or serialized. Public encodings exist only in memory. Evidence contains no keys, signatures or payload bytes.

The proof checks binding behavior and sizes against FIPS 204, not certification of the OpenSSL default provider, interoperability with another implementation, production suitability, TLS or contracts.
